lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso from the rump to the base of the neck. Spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection, with slightly tighter intervals between the four most anterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first line on the posterior rump is fragmented into three distinct segments. The third, fourth, and fifth lines from the posterior terminate significantly above the ventral line compared to the central stripes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch above the hock. An additional 2 spots are located on the flank area between the 1st and 3rd vertical lines.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align horizontally to form a semi-continuous geometric line segment approximately mid-way down the hind limb profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent white spots on the malar region of the face. A yellow insect-like object is visible in the air immediately posterior to the right ear.
